scenario: Each recompute of a surface primitive whose solid has more than one shell leaks the shell wrappers returned by explore(): only made.shape is deleted, and combine() builds a compound from the shells without releasing them.
fix: After const shape = combine(shells), call K.del(shells) when shells.length > 1 (the compound copies the topology, so the wrappers can be released). Keep the single-shell case as is, because combine() then returns that shell itself and applyOp takes ownership of it.
